parameters: We have lost Fort Eureeka and our core armies, my lord...\! Duke Terenor died in battle, but we are now defenseless...
And what few men we have left are trying to quell the rioting...\! Donar save us all...
I need you to get the word to the people.\! The war ends now.\! I don't care what they do to me.\! I want my people to know the nobility is not lost.
Terenor, you old fool...\! You gave your life for nothing...
Two hundred, seventy four.\! Rest in peace, Lothair.
